articles.summary: Board of Directors declares $0.40 regular quarterly cash dividend on common stock, resulting in a current annual yield of approximately 2.7 percent Mercantile Bank Corporation (NASDAQ: MBWM) ("Mercantile") announced today that on October 15, 2026, its Board of Directors declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.40 per common share, payable on December 16, 2026, to holders of record as of December 4, 2026. The $0.40 cash dividend represents an increase of 5.3 percent from the cash dividend paid during the fourth quarter of 2025. "We are pleased that our financial performance metrics remained robust during the third quarter of 2026, which permitted us to continue our cash dividend program and once more provide shareholders with meaningful cash returns on their investments," said Ray Reitsma, President and Chief Executive Officer of Mercantile. articles.summary: Mercantile Bank Corporation (NASDAQ: MBWM) ("Mercantile") reported net income of $24.1 million, or $1.39 per diluted share, for the third quarter of 2026, compared with net income of $23.8 million, or $1.46 per diluted share, for the third quarter of 2025. Net income during the first nine months of 2026 totaled $72.7 million, or $4.21 per diluted share, compared with net income of $65.9 million, or $4.06 per diluted share, during the first nine months of 2025.
